breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It correctly identified that the vertical direction should be aligned with the gravity vector (-Z), but it failed to implement this change correctly. The specification still defines the mesh domain to be 0.4m tall in the Y-direction and only 0.01m thick in the Z-direction (`block spanning (0 0 0) to (0.6 0.4 0.01)`). However, it then defines the initial water column to be 0.3m high in the Z-direction (`z < 0.3 m`). This creates a new, fatal error where the water column is defined almost entirely outside the computational domain, making the setup invalid.
